name: Human_Sword_and_Shield_Hold
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: game-ready bare base-body holding-pose sprite sheet.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY edit target and exact approved game sprite identity/style. Image 2 is ONLY an arm pose guide; do NOT copy its larger, smoother, exaggerated muscular rendering.
PRIMARY REQUEST: pose the exact small bald human pixel-art base body from Image 1 into the holding stances from Image 2, but with ABSOLUTELY NO WEAPONS, NO SHIELD, and NO ARMOR visible anywhere. The hands grip EMPTY AIR as attachment poses for gear to be layered later. The missing equipment locations must be completely transparent.
Preserve Image 1's head size, body proportions, simple square black/white eyes, fair tan skin palette and restrained 3-tone anatomy shading. Bald bare head, bare torso, bare arms, bare hands, simple dark charcoal cloth shorts, bare legs and bare feet. No helmet, footwear, bands, gloves, straps, jewelry or belt.
Style: authentic low-resolution 64x64 RPG character pixel art as in Image 1. Each figure approximately 50-56 logical pixels high; deliberate chunky pixel clusters, square stair-step contours, crisp dark outline, NO fine high-resolution anatomy, NO smooth gradients or antialiasing. Display at integer nearest-neighbor enlargement so the pixels remain visible.
Layout: exactly FOUR whole figures in one horizontal row, order front/South, back/North, right-facing/East, left-facing/West, all same size and same foot baseline. Generous transparent gaps between figures, true transparent background, no ground shadows, no text or grids. Show the entire uncovered body including parts previously hidden by the shield in the pose guide. Pose: anatomical RIGHT elbow gently bent with closed right grip upright beside lower chest, as if holding a vertical sword. Anatomical LEFT forearm bent forward across lower torso ready for a shield strap; left empty hand visible. Side views right fist forward of chest, left forearm presented naturally for absent shield. All shield, blade, hilt and pommel are omitted. Do not relax both arms to sides. These are sword-and-shield HOLDING POSES with no equipment.
